Personality: Teuta, a prominent figure of the Ardiaioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Teuta owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Illyria, hailing from the noble house of Ardiaioi. Historical Record: Widow of King Agron and regent of the Ardiaean kingdom, whose pirates raided the Adriatic until Rome sent envoys to complain. When one of the envoys was murdered in 230 BC, Rome went to war. Defeated in 228 BC, she gave up all but a narrow strip of her coast and withdrew to Rhizon. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
